redistributionDecision: Allowed per source under its repository-wide licence (table below); each source's licence files are retained byte-identical under licenses/<key>/. The decks are redistributed verbatim as separate benchmark data files: test inputs, not linked into or distributed with any MIT-licensed spice-ts package. Decks that carry their own copyright or licence notice are excluded and not committed.
mechanicalAdaptation: None. Every fixture is byte-identical to its pinned upstream revision (SHA-256 pinned per file), and both engines read the same bytes.

sources.name: FOSSEE eSim example circuits
sources.licenseBasis: Repository-wide GNU GPL v3 (`LICENSE`; README "eSim is licensed under the GNU General Public License v3.0"). The only nested licence file (`src/converter/LTSpiceToKiCadConverter/LICENSE`) is outside the `Examples/` root.

sources.name: KiCad EDA simulation demos
sources.licenseBasis: `LICENSE.README`: "Licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0: All the demo files provided in demos/*". CC BY-SA 4.0 permits verbatim redistribution with attribution; the licence text is retained. Only SPICE text committed upstream is a candidate: `.kicad_sch` schematics are not netlists, and a kicad-cli export would be an adaptation.

sources.name: ngspice-cmos (NGSPICE simulation of CMOS circuits, FreePDK45)
sources.licenseBasis: Repository-wide MIT licence (`LICENSE`, "Copyright (c) 2023 Wuqiong Zhao (Teddy van Jerry)"; README "distributed by an MIT license"), retained as the MIT notice requires.

sources.name: ngspice-examples (gEDA/ngspice RC low-pass examples)
sources.licenseBasis: Repository-wide GNU GPL v3 (`LICENSE`, GitHub licence metadata gpl-3.0).

sources.name: VACASK simulator benchmarks and demos
sources.licenseBasis: Repository-wide GNU AGPL v3 (`LICENSE`; README "free software released under the GNU Affero General Public License 3.0"). The `benchmark/<circuit>/ngspice*/` decks are VACASK's own ngspice reference netlists; the VACASK, Xyce and Gnucap variants are candidates too and are decided by the ngspice probe.

rules: Candidates: every git-tracked file at the pinned revision of each source, under the listed roots, whose name ends in .cir, .sp, .net, .ckt, .spi, .deck, .cki, .spice, .sim or .cir.out.
skipped-path: the path is under a prefix the source table skips, with the reason given there.

already-in-corpus: the bytes (or the bytes without a terminal newline) hash-match a fixture of an existing public corpus (every other directory under benchmarks/corpus, including corpus-h and ngspice-bugs).
duplicate-content: the bytes hash-match an earlier candidate (sources in key order, paths sorted); the first is kept.
licence: the deck carries a copyright or licence notice that the repository-wide licence cannot be assumed to cover (corpus-f rule, unchanged). Not committed.
not-utf8: the bytes are not lossless UTF-8, so spice-ts cannot receive the identical deck through its string API.
host-command: the deck runs shell or gnuplot commands on the host.
not-self-contained: the deck loads another file (.include/.lib/OSDI/source) or names a sibling upstream file, so it cannot run unchanged in an isolated directory.
no-analysis: no analysis card or control-block analysis command.

ngspice-no-reference: ngspice-47 run on the identical bytes (batch mode, 60 s bound) did not exit 0 with at least one op/dc/ac/tran/pz/noise/disto plot in its raw file, so there is no reference to compare against. The probe result and ngspice's first error line are recorded in ngspice-probe.json. spice-ts is not run during selection.
directory-cap: at most 16 decks per upstream directory (per source), first in path order, among decks that passed every rule above. Capped decks are listed below for later batches.
